_comment: Print poses for parts whose STL is not exported in the pose they print in. The catalog says so in each part's 'Print orientation' attribute; this file turns that note into a rotation. 'lay-flat' rests the part on its largest flat face, 'flip' turns it upside down, 'matrix' is an explicit 3x3 rotation (column vectors, applied about the part's bounding-box centre). 'derived_from' names the STL a matrix was measured on: when the catalog ships a different file the hint is still applied and the build warns.

frame-90deg-bracket.source: the curated 90-deg-brackets.3mf plate (corner down, legs rising at 45 degrees)
